# AFOS Daily · Daily Brief

## 1. Prediction market

Sunday inverted the mechanism of the two previous sessions. [Lula](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) held **flat at 65.50% (USD 7.90M)** and **Flávio Bolsonaro fell 0.20pp, to 24.55% (USD 7.82M)**, breaking six sessions without a decline: the gap widened to **+40.95pp** from the rival's side, not the favourite's. The series high is now behind us, and the window has to be stated: Lula's maximum is **66.50%** and the gap maximum is **+41.80pp**, both from the August 1 close, in a 108-day series checked straight against the database. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market is **USD 118.11M**.

**Renan Santos was the only strong move: up 0.35pp, to 7.95% (USD 8.82M)**, breaking nine rounds of decline and rising in all three books, with **63.50% in [third place](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place) (USD 168K)**. The turn does not undo the arc: he came from 12.00% on July 23 and touched 7.10% on August 1, and it is not a series low, which is 5.30%, from April 26.

**[Caiado](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) touched the series floor within the day itself:** the 11:30 UTC collection recorded **0.90%**, the lowest value since April 14, and the locked capture at 19:42 shows **1.15% (USD 5.27M)**. The panel publishes the locked one and records the intraday floor.

The chasing pack split: Camilo Santana and Jair rose to 0.65%, Zema fell to 0.25% and Tarcísio remains at 0.05%, with **USD 13.70M**, the largest volume in the book. The [impeachment of an STF justice](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) held flat at **3.10% (USD 83K)** for a fourth session. On [inflation](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026), the ten bands add up to **94.15%**, below the 95% floor AFOS requires before reading a distribution as legible probability.

## 2. What the pollsters recorded

There was no fresh national poll, and the absence was confirmed two ways: the TSE sweep read **538 filings and inserted none**, and no outlet published new national numbers. The most recent remains **Vox Brasil of July 31** (n=2,100, BR-01084/2026), with Lula 40.5% x Flávio 31.2% and 47.5% x 41.1% in the runoff. ## 3. What the press covered

The fact of the day is the PT national convention, in São Paulo, which [formally launched Lula](https://news.google.?oc=5) in his eighth run, with Alckmin as running mate and [**seven parties in the coalition**](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes-2026/pt-formaliza-candidatura-de-lula-neste-domingo-em-sao-paulo/), the largest left and centre-left alliance since 1989. In [Folha de S.Paulo](https://news.google.?oc=5), he says he does not want to be the Bolsa Família president and promises to fight Congress over budget earmarks.

Flávio Bolsonaro spent Sunday at the [PL state convention in Paraíba](https://news.google.?oc=5), which launched Efraim Filho for governor and Marcelo Queiroga for the Senate. [Poder360](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes-2026/ao-vivo-pl-realiza-convencao-estadual-na-paraiba/) records the trip as a strategy to widen his presence in the Northeast, the rival's historic stronghold. He still has **no running mate three days from the deadline**. [Valor Econômico](https://news.google.?oc=5) sums up the cycle: the two reached the final stretch without broadening alliances, with the Centrão neutral.

On August 1, and not today, Lula and Flávio [asked for votes ahead of the legal window](https://news.google.?oc=5), in Bahia and in Santa Catarina; the campaign only opens on August 16. On that same day, Missão [launched Renan Santos](https://news.google.?oc=5), after formally confirming him at a convention brought forward to July 20.

On the judicial axis, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/poder/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/08/inqueritos-sobre-lulinha-acirram-tensao-entre-mendonca-e-pf.shtml) records that the two inquiries into Lulinha, of July 30 and 31, sharpened the tension between Mendonça and the Federal Police. An inquiry is not a conviction. In the Master case, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/08/01/pf-aponta-interesse-de-vorcaro-em-emendas-apresentadas-no-senado-em-projeto-que-regulamentava-mercado-de-carbono.ghtml) reports that the Federal Police points to Vorcaro's interest in Senate amendments, and the [PT admitted](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPd29FZkI3alZRU2psMXFTZEcxTWVMdzRCbl9BS3d1WU52WVNSZThvSEpTd1c0Qzd1MmwxaFdVeXpPaEVMaENaY24wQzU0TEd6cUpwdGtzRUJJdTh6Q25tVEtWaExLSHpRS01lNGVMVFpLSUlvUFBnNG13dXBMRFlWYVYtYmdDSkNtQlZkMVlvTVpOQkxTZjFLUUhPeWVSdHd0TllWZ3lwb2FlZw?oc=5) that the deal to keep the case out of the Bahia race collapsed.

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market × event:** the favourite's price stood still on exactly the day his party formally launched him, with seven parties on stage. The panel records the coincidence of dates and does not turn it into a cause.

> **Market × polling:** Renan rose 0.35pp on a day with no poll and no event of his own, because his launch was on August 1. With polling at 3.0% and the price at 7.95%, the distance widened again, from 4.60pp to 4.95pp, on the price side.

> **Panel × panel:** two collection caveats change what can be asserted today, and they belong to AFOS, not to the market. The series has no August 1 point for Camilo Santana and no point after July 30 for Zema, which is why the panel does not repeat about Camilo the series-low sentence it published the day before.

## In summary

1. The gap went to **+40.95pp** because Flávio gave ground, and stays below the maximum of **+41.80pp**, from August 1.
2. **Renan Santos** broke nine rounds of decline with no polling and no event on the date.
3. Polling is stalled, but with a time set: **four national polls publish by August 5**.
